topic: Part 6.15 Silent-Ignore Cohort — verification of H1 (cohort completeness) + H2 (column rename) patches
change_summary: Decider patched p6-615: added PRED-072/084 to the cohort (H1), renamed the table column Dome status -> Status (author-side, reconstructed) (H2). Verification re-review of whether the fixes landed cleanly and the completeness claim is now accurate.
our_argument_summary: The dome registers falsifiable predictions but only updates its scoreboard on confirmation; closed-window/no-result predictions sit indefinitely as pending, so the win tally is computed over a process that never records a loss. Cohort is now 12 entries; independent column resolves to nine standard_physics/recycled, two tacit_withdrawal, one falsified — none dome-discriminating.

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Section is aggregation prose over predictions.json. Re-verified all 12 cohort rows against predictions.json entries[]: every our_verdict matches (087/088/111/085/077/081/072/084 standard_physics; 090 recycled; 106/105 tacit_withdrawal; 073 falsified). Completeness re-checked: enumerated ALL entry_type=prediction entries; every one with author_status in {dome_silent_terminal,dome_silent} (12 total) is in the cohort, and every other pending prediction has a future or unset test_window_closes (none closed before 2026-06-09). MT-003 (manual_test) and PROS-003 (prospective) remain the only closed/unresolved non-PRED entries, defensibly out of scope per c1.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Silence-day counts are static snapshots. The two newly-added rows (072/084) were computed as-of 2026-06-09 (59d, correct today); the pre-existing eight 04-30 rows and 105/073 are still as-of 2026-06-08 (39/51/8d — one day stale today). Mixed snapshot date.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: PRED-073 falsified verdict explicitly caveated as rule-based-under-consensus-null.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: Two prose/data discrepancies remain after the patch: (1) the objections paragraph still says seven restate standard physics while the headline tally (correctly) says nine — incomplete H1 propagation. (2) The cohort table shows the eight 2026-04-30 rows as pending, but predictions.json carries author_status=dome_silent_terminal for all eight; the same column shows dome_silent_terminal for 072/084/105 — an internal display inconsistency and a data-prose mismatch.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: Section is an aggregation over predictions.json; no monitor.py automation fetches or compares these silent-ignore entries — that silence is the entire point of the section.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: This is our review section, not a dome WIN; n/a as a relabel. The underlying predictions it audits resolve to standard_physics/recycled (nine of twelve), but the section makes no physical claim of its own.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: n/a — review-side section; values are read from predictions.json, not derived from dome geometry.

holes_found.description: STALE STANDARD-PHYSICS COUNT — the section contradicts its own headline tally. After adding PRED-072/084 (both standard_physics), the headline Scoreboard tally was correctly updated to nine standard_physics/recycled, two tacit_withdrawal, one falsified (9+2+1=12). But the third Anticipated-objections rebuttal (Silence is not the same as a wrong answer) still reads: We score each prediction on its physics (seven restate standard physics, two are tacit withdrawals, one is falsified on the dome rule) — i.e. 7+2+1=10, the PRE-patch 10-entry breakdown. So within one section the tally says nine and the objections say seven. This is the H1 patch failing to propagate to the duplicate count. It is the most exploitable defect possible here: a dome defender gets to quote the very section that accuses the dome of selective/incoherent bookkeeping and show it cannot keep its own headline count straight.
holes_found.recommendation: Change seven restate standard physics -> nine restate standard physics in the Silence is not the same as a wrong answer paragraph. Then grep the whole subsection once more for any other pre-12 count (seven/ten where the post-patch value should be nine/twelve).

holes_found.description: STATUS-DISPLAY INCONSISTENCY (H2 residual + data mismatch). The renamed column Status (author-side, reconstructed) shows the eight 2026-04-30 rows as pending 39d silent, but predictions.json author_status for all eight is dome_silent_terminal; meanwhile PRED-072/084/105 are shown as dome_silent_terminal in the same column. So the column mixes two conventions (raw dome value vs reconstructed terminal value) for entries that are identical in kind, and the eight pending displays contradict the underlying data. Compounding it, the Author-status standardization block says these ten entries are recommended to move from pending to dome_silent_terminal (future tense) — but predictions.json already shows the move applied. The c1 H2 fix renamed the header but introduced this raw/reconstructed split rather than resolving it.
holes_found.recommendation: Pick ONE convention for the reconstructed column and apply it to all ten 14+-day-silent rows: simplest is to show dome_silent_terminal for all ten (matches predictions.json and the reconstructed header), keep PRED-073 as dome_silent. Then change the standardization prose from are recommended to move from pending to dome_silent_terminal -> have been moved... (past tense), since the data is already flipped. Alternative (if raw display is wanted) is to show pending for ALL untouched entries including 072/084/105 and add an inline (reconstructed: dome_silent_terminal) marker — but that re-opens the original H2 misread, so the all-terminal option is preferred.

holes_found.description: CARRY-OVER (c1 H3 / ISS-2676): provenance of the zero dome-posted results claim is still not inline for 10 of 12 rows. Only PRED-073 and PRED-105 carry an explicit live-site no-result confirmation; the eight 2026-04-30 entries plus 072/084 assert dome silence without an inline date the dome predictions page was checked. This patch addressed H1/H2 only, so the moderate provenance hole tracked as ISS-2676 remains open and the load-bearing zero is still partly inferred from our own catalog rather than the dome published surface (CLAUDE.md reason-from-published-surface discipline).
holes_found.recommendation: Per ISS-2676: add a one-line provenance note (section-level or per-row) citing the date the dome predictions page was last checked and found to carry no result for these IDs, mirroring the PRED-073 confirmed-2026-06-05 pattern.

holes_found.description: MIXED SNAPSHOT DATES (c1 H5 carry-over, slightly worsened by the patch). The two newly-added rows (072/084) show 59d silent computed as-of 2026-06-09 (correct today), while the pre-existing rows still show 39/51/8d as-of 2026-06-08 (today they are 40/52/9d). The patch normalized neither, so the table now carries two different as-of dates. Cosmetic, but it reads as auto-updating when it is a fixed snapshot.
holes_found.recommendation: Prefix the silence figures with an as-of <date> note (single date for the whole table) and recompute all rows to the same date. Not blocking.

holes_found.description: DANGLING COLUMN NAME in the explanatory sentence. The intro sentence before the table still says: Dome status is the author-side posture in the dome own record... but the table header was renamed to Status (author-side, reconstructed). A reader matching the explanation to the header sees a name that no longer exists.
holes_found.recommendation: Update the explanatory sentence to use the new column name (Status (author-side, reconstructed)) instead of Dome status.

stronger_arguments.description: Once the status column is made consistent (all ten 14+-day rows shown as dome_silent_terminal), the table itself becomes the visual proof of the asymmetry: a single terminal-silence column with zero confirmations, against a separately-growing win count. Quantify it: state the dome win-count delta over 2026-04 to 2026-06 next to the 0/12 posted-result count.

kernel_of_truth.description: The H1 fix genuinely strengthened the section: the cohort completeness claim now holds at the data level. On independent re-enumeration of predictions.json (data/predictions.json:entries), every entry_type=prediction with author_status dome_silent_terminal or dome_silent is present in the twelve-row cohort, and no pending prediction with a closed test_window_closes is omitted (all remaining pending predictions have future or unset close dates as of 2026-06-09). The arithmetic of the headline tally is also internally correct (nine + two + one = twelve, data/sections.json:p6-615-silent-ignore-cohort). Adding PRED-072/084 also made the strongest version of the point — the oldest closed-no-result predictions are the most silent (59d vs 39d).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The patch closed the structural completeness hole but did not finish the text: the duplicate standard-physics count in the objections paragraph still reads seven (data/sections.json:p6-615-silent-ignore-cohort), so the section now visibly disagrees with its own headline nine — a self-inflicted inconsistency in the one section whose thesis is bookkeeping integrity. And the H2 column rename left the cohort table showing pending for eight rows that predictions.json marks dome_silent_terminal (data/predictions.json:PRED-087 .. PRED-106), so the reconstructed column is half-raw, half-reconstructed. Both are small text edits but until they land the section is not yet airtight on exactly the axis where a dome defender will press.

deeper_analysis: Verification outcome: H1 PARTIAL, H2 PARTIAL, H3/H5 untouched (out of patch scope). (1) Cohort completeness (the c1 major hole) is now SATISFIED at the data level — re-enumerated predictions.json and confirmed all 12 closed-no-result PRED-class entries are listed and no closed-window pending prediction is omitted; MT-003/PROS-003 defensibly excluded. (2) Headline tally correctly updated to twelve / nine-two-one. (3) BUT the H1 patch missed the duplicate count in the third objections rebuttal, which still says seven restate standard physics — section contradicts itself (major). (4) The H2 column rename landed but the eight 04-30 rows now display pending while predictions.json marks them dome_silent_terminal and the same column shows dome_silent_terminal for 072/084/105 — data-prose mismatch + internal inconsistency, and the standardization prose still says recommended to move (future) though the data is already flipped (moderate). (5) Provenance (ISS-2676, moderate) and snapshot-date drift (minor) remain. Net: section thesis holds and current_verdict_holds=true, but it should NOT be considered closed — the major stale-count contradiction needs a one-word fix (seven->nine) and the status column needs to be made consistent. Recommend the decider self-apply both as minor edits and re-verify.
